0022600174.text: The Atlanta Hawks (4-4, sixth in the East, 3-2 on the road, riding a one-game win streak) visit the Washington Wizards (4-3, first in the Southeast and fifth in the East, on a two-game win streak). Atlanta is missing Henri Veesaar (knee), Jalen Johnson (ankle), Jock Landale (hip), Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture), and Kingston Flemings (suspension), while Washington is without Alex Sarr (knee soreness), Anthony Gill (back spasms), Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), Justin Champagnie (foot), Reece Beekman (shoulder), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip, pinched nerve). The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and the Hawks won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 126-96 win in Atlanta on February 26.
